nodes.text: @Leslie64993617 It was a very rough night & I had very little sleep. The diagnosis of the misdiagnosis turned out to be incorrect. I have human metapneumovirus confirmed. No idea what the plan is. Waiting to hear from the doctors. I'm currently feeling okay & breathing fine. TY for asking!

nodes.author: Leakydrum
nodes.text: @jakki_jax @Leslie64993617 Not to worry as for most people it is not more than a bad cold.

nodes.author: jakki_jax
nodes.text: @Leakydrum @Leslie64993617 Yeah if it were just a "bad cold" for me I wouldn't be laying in a hospital bed with an IV in my hand getting CTs and IV meds. 🤷

nodes.author: Leakydrum
nodes.text: @jakki_jax @Leslie64993617 Sounds like it hit you hard and we all hope you will soon feel great

nodes.author: Leslie64993617
nodes.text: @jakki_jax I’m so sorry you’re going through this -misdiagnosis can be very frightening.  I had a mild case of bacterial pneumonia a year ago. Source unknown, but it scared the crap out of me.  🤞🏻
